notes: Stories refined for clearer separation of rendering vs integration and explicit map library responsibility.

change_log.value: Explicitly includes map library initialization (e.g., Leaflet/Google Maps), viewport control, and marker lifecycle management.
Expanded to include bidirectional sync between marker selection and chat/provider list context.
Clarified real-time update behavior including re-render on new queries and partial result streaming handling.

stories.title: Map Data Contract for Provider Locations
stories.description: Define strict frontend map data contract aligned to provider schema including provider_id, name, latitude, longitude, specialty, and display metadata. Include transformation rules from provider_search_service output to map-ready format.

stories.title: Core Map Rendering Component
stories.description: Implement core frontend map component using a mapping library (e.g., Leaflet or Google Maps) including map initialization, viewport bounds handling, dynamic centering based on results, and marker lifecycle management using the defined contract.

stories.title: Provider Marker UI and Interaction
stories.description: Build UI logic for interactive provider markers including hover/click states, info popups with provider details, and bidirectional selection synchronization with provider list or chat context.

stories.title: Integration with Provider Search Results
stories.description: Integrate map component with provider search API responses to dynamically update markers based on search queries, including re-rendering on new queries, handling empty states, and supporting incremental/streaming result updates.

stories.title: Map Rendering and Interaction Tests
stories.description: Develop frontend tests validating map initialization, marker rendering accuracy, interaction behavior, contract compliance, and synchronization with provider search results.
